description: Erection of a single storey extension to existing outbuilding to the rear of the garden to use as storage, gym and children play area
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (304/HR/101, 304/HR/102 Received: 1 April 2022 Fire Strategy [23/04/2022], 304/HR/107 Received 25 April 2022 304/HR/103, 304/HR/104 Received 1 June 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted at the address 304 Heston Road, TW5 0HQ shall not be used other than for purposes incidental to the occupation of the main dwelling and for the avoidance of doubt shall not be used as primary living accommodation such as a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or living room or for business purposes.
